Placemaker.Park.bikePath.Tooltip: A wide cycle route through the park between two far-apart entrances, kept apart from the footpaths and crossing them square. Uses a bike path when one is installed, otherwise a wide path.
Placemaker.Park.bikeGap.Tooltip: How far the bike route keeps from footpaths running alongside it.
Placemaker.Park.bikeAsset.Tooltip: Automatic picks the two-way bike path, then a path with bike lanes, then a wide footpath.
Placemaker.Park.smallPaths.Tooltip: Narrow paths across the larger lawns, joining two main paths.
Placemaker.Park.trails.Tooltip: Informal trails winding through the planted belt along the park's edge, joined to the nearest path.
Placemaker.Park.trailAsset.Tooltip: Automatic picks a gravel or dirt path when one is installed, otherwise a footpath.
Placemaker.Park.desireLines.Tooltip: Desire lines: shortcuts people take where the paths make them walk around. Worn = trodden ground (terrain paint), paved = small paths.
Placemaker.Park.desireLayer.Tooltip: Terrain texture layer (1–4, depends on the map) used for worn ground.
Placemaker.Park.Issue.BikeNeedsTwoEntran: The bike route needs two entrances at least 40 m apart.
Placemaker.Park.Issue.NoBikeRoute: No room for a bike route through the park.
Placemaker.Park.Issue.FewerSmallPaths: Fewer small paths fit than asked for.
Placemaker.Park.Issue.NoRoomForTrails: No room for dirt trails along the edge.
Placemaker.Park.Issue.NoDesireLines: The paths are already direct: no shortcuts needed.
Placemaker.Feature.ground.Tooltip: Patches of dirt, mown grass, meadow, rocks, gravel or sand with soft, blended edges.
